I have been a patient here for several years and in that time I have had two referrals rejected. Not because my case wasn't serious enough — but because the doctor apparently wrote the referral on the back of a receipt while thinking about something else.
The doctor listened carefully with one ear while the other ear appeared to be on a short break. The referral that followed contained approximately none of what was discussed.
I understand the NHS is under pressure. I understand doctors are busy. What I don't understand is how a referral letter can be written about a patient without appearing to mention the patient.
Two referrals. Two rejections. One ear in, one ear out.“I only got my referrals because I complained relentlessly — practically had to fight every step of the way. Wellington Medical Practice — Save The NHS Money.
Terrible place if you plan on living long. Avoid at all costs.
If you enjoy being a medical mystery that nobody is particularly interested in solving, this is the practice for you.
